title: nf-core/scdownstream pipeline parameters
description: A single cell transcriptomics pipeline for QC, integration and making the results presentable

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/scdownstream/usage#samplesheet-input).

metadata.description: Path to a tab-separated file with per-sample metadata to add to the cells' obs.
metadata.help_text: Tab-separated file with a header row and one row per sample. The column named by `--metadata_sample_col` holds the `sample` ids from the samplesheet; every other column is added to the `obs` table of that sample's cells. A metadata column that already exists in `obs` is an error. Only used by `-entry qc_clustering`.

metadata_sample_col.description: Column in the `--metadata` file that holds the samplesheet sample ids.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

save_intermediates.description: Save intermediate files to the output directory

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

name.description: Name that will be used for output files.

unify_options.title: Unify options
unify_options.description: Options for converting the input data to the unified format.

unify_gene_symbols.description: Unify gene symbols to the latest version of the Ensembl database

duplicate_var_resolution.description: Method to aggregate gene expression values for non-unique genes
duplicate_var_resolution.help_text: Method to aggregate gene expression values for non-unique genes. Available methods are: mean, sum, max, make_unique

force_obs_cols.description: Force keeping certain columns in the merged AnnData object, even if they are not present in all samples
force_obs_cols.help_text: If you want to keep certain columns in the merged AnnData object, even if they are not present in all samples, specify them here. Separate them with a comma.

aggregate_isoforms.description: Aggregate isoforms of the same gene. If set to true, genes like 'SOD2.1' will be renamed to 'SOD2' before `duplicate_var_resolution` is applied. All numeric suffixes following a dot will be removed.

quality_control_options.title: Quality control options
quality_control_options.description: Options for quality control of the input data.

mito_genes.description: Optional file containing a list of mitochondrial gene symbols (one per line). If provided, it overrides the default 'mt-' prefix heuristic.

ambient_correction.description: Tool to use for ambient RNA correction. The default 'none' performs no ambient RNA correction.
ambient_correction.help_text: The default is 'none' because the expected input, nf-core/scrnaseq output processed with CellBender, is already corrected for ambient RNA. For input that was not corrected upstream, choose 'decontx', 'soupx', 'cellbender' or 'scar'. When a method is set, the per-sample 'ambient_correction' column in the samplesheet can only switch correction off for individual samples. By default, the ambient-corrected counts are NOT used for integration but only stored as an additional layer (`ambient_corrected_<method>`) in the final AnnData object, because of the findings in [this publication](https://genomebiology.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s13059-023-02978-x). To use the ambient-corrected counts for integration, set `--ambient_corrected_integration` or the `ambient_corrected_integration` column in the samplesheet.

ambient_corrected_integration.description: Whether to use the ambient-corrected counts for integration. Can be overridden by the `ambient_corrected_integration` in the sample sheet.

doublet_detection.description: Specify the tools to use for doublet detection. Setting to 'none' will skip this step
doublet_detection.help_text: If you want to use multiple tools, separate them with a comma. Available methods are: solo, scrublet, doubletdetection, scds

doublet_detection_threshold.description: Number of tools that need to agree on a doublet for it to be called as such. Used with `--doublet_removal`.
doublet_detection_threshold.help_text: With `--doublet_removal`, a cell is removed if at least this many of the methods in `--doublet_detection` call it a doublet (default 1: any method). Without `--doublet_removal`, no cells are removed and this value has no effect.

doublet_removal.description: Remove cells called doublets by at least --doublet_detection_threshold methods, right after doublet detection.
doublet_removal.help_text: By default, no cells are removed and doublets are only annotated: `predicted_doublet` in obs holds the scrublet call (if scrublet is among the `--doublet_detection` methods). With this option, cells called doublets by at least `--doublet_detection_threshold` of the methods in `--doublet_detection` are removed right after doublet detection, before ambient correction and QC filtering. This is independent of `--filtering_keep_outliers`, which only affects the QC thresholds.

cellbender_epochs.description: Number of epochs to train the CellBender model

automatic_cell_filtering.description: Perform automatic filtering of cells based.

filtering_keep_outliers.description: Keep cells that fail the QC thresholds and mark them in obs['outlier'] instead of removing them.
filtering_keep_outliers.help_text: Works with both the fixed thresholds (`--min_genes`, `--max_genes`, `--min_counts`, `--max_counts`, `--max_mito_percentage`) and the automatic thresholds (`--automatic_cell_filtering`). The marked cells stay in the data and go through integration, clustering and the reports, so they can be inspected (e.g. on the UMAP) before deciding to remove them. Gene filtering (`--min_cells`, `--min_counts_gene`) is unchanged.

min_cells.description: Required minimum number of cells that express gene.
min_cells.help_text: Genes that are expressed in less cells are removed.

min_counts_gene.description: Required minimum number of counts for a gene.
min_counts_gene.help_text: Genes with less counts are removed.

min_genes.description: Required minimum number of genes that are expressed in cell.
min_genes.help_text: Cells with less expressed genes are removed.

max_genes.description: Maximum number of genes that are expressed in cell.
max_genes.help_text: Cells with more expressed genes are removed. Use 'false' to not filter by maximum number of genes.

min_counts.description: Required minimum number of counts per cell.
min_counts.help_text: Cells with less expressed counts are removed.

max_counts.description: Maximum number of counts per cell.
max_counts.help_text: Cells with more counts are removed. Use 'false' to not filter by maximum counts.

max_mito_percentage.help_text: Cells that have a higher percentage will be removed.

symbol_col.description: Gene symbol column used for filtering.
symbol_col.help_text: This is usually the 'index' of the anndata object.

integration_options.title: Integration options
integration_options.description: Options for integration of the input data. For configuration of the scVI/scANVI models, see the `scVI_options` section.

integration_methods.description: Specify the tool to use for integration
integration_methods.help_text: If you want to use multiple tools, separate them with a comma. Available methods are: scvi, scanvi, harmony, bbknn, combat, seurat

integration_hvgs.description: Number of highly variable genes to use for integration. If set to 0, the number of highly variable genes will be automatically determined. If set to a negative number, all genes will be used.
integration_hvgs.help_text: If a reference model is provided, this does not have any effect. This is because the reference model defines the set of genes that will be used for integration.

scvi_model.description: Path to a pre-trained scVI model, only relevant if scVI is selected in `integration_methods`. If provided, the model will be used for integration. Otherwise, a new model will be trained.
scvi_model.help_text: The file should be in the .pt format.

scanvi_model.description: Path to a pre-trained scANVI model, only relevant if scANVI is selected in `integration_methods`. If provided, the model will be used for integration. Otherwise, a new model will be trained.
scanvi_model.help_text: The file should be in the .pt format.

scimilarity_model.description: Path to a pre-trained scimilarity model, only relevant if scimilarity is selected in `integration_methods`. If provided, the model will be used for integration. Otherwise, a new model will be trained.
scimilarity_model.help_text: The file can be a .tar.gz file or the corresponding unzipped directory. The official models are shared via [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/record/10685499).

n_hvgs.description: Number of highly variable genes to use for data processing. If set to 0, the number of highly variable genes will be automatically determined. If set to a negative number, all genes will be used.
n_hvgs.help_text: This is the number of HVGs for single sample processing and after data integration.

pca_n_comps.description: Number of principal components computed (stored in `X_pca`).
pca_n_comps.help_text: The PCA neighbour graph uses the first `--neighbors_n_pcs` of these components. Only set this higher if the elbow plot in the QC/clustering report suggests that more than 50 components are informative.

neighbors_n_pcs.description: Number of principal components used to build the PCA neighbour graph (and the PCA UMAP). Default: all computed PCs.
neighbors_n_pcs.help_text: Must not exceed `--pca_n_comps`. Look at the elbow plot in the QC/clustering report, then rerun `-entry qc_clustering` with this option and `-resume`; the scVI integration is reused from the cache. This does not affect the scVI graph or the default clustering (which uses the scVI graph) unless `--cluster_neighbors neighbors_pca` is set.

extension_options.title: Extension options
extension_options.description: If you already produced an integrated AnnData object with this pipeline and want to add new data to it, you can specify the path to the base AnnData object and some information about it here. This will allow you to project the new data onto the existing integrated object.

base_adata.description: If you want to project new data onto an already integrated object, specify the path to the base AnnData object here
base_adata.help_text: The file should be in the .h5ad format.

base_label_col.description: The column in the base AnnData object that contains the label (e.g. cell type) information.

base_embeddings.description: The keys in the obsm of the base AnnData object that contain the embeddings (without leading `X_`). Required if `input` is not provided - otherwise it is ignored.
base_embeddings.help_text: If the `input` parameter is not provided (no new data to add), integration will not be performed. In order to be able to utilize existing integration results, you need to provide the keys in the obsm of the base AnnData object that contain the embeddings (without leading `X_`).

clustering_options.title: Clustering options
clustering_options.description: Options for clustering the integrated data.

clustering_resolutions.help_text: Specify the resolutions for clustering. If you want to use multiple resolutions, separate them with a comma.

cluster_per_label.description: Create a UMAP and a clustering for each unique value in the label column (and for each integration method)

cluster_global.description: Create a global UMAP and clustering (for each integration method)

cluster_neighbors.description: Specify uns key for storing neighborhood graph.
cluster_neighbors.help_text: Any uns key for storing neighborhood graph can be used.

selected_clustering.help_text: Select the clustering for downstream analysis. Any label in the obs table can be used.

species.help_text: Species for gene set enrichment and ligand-receptor interactions analysis.

report_table_row_limit.description: Table row limit for downstream analysis report.
report_table_row_limit.help_text: The top N entries will be displayed in the report to avoid overly large or slow HTML files.

umap_for_plots.description: UMAP (key in adata.obsm) used for the default plots in the QC/clustering and analysis reports.
umap_for_plots.help_text: `X_umap_scvi` (default) is the UMAP on the scVI neighbour graph, the graph clustering uses. `X_umap_pca` is the UMAP on the PCA neighbour graph. `X_umap` holds a copy of `X_umap_pca` only because tools such as `sc.pl.umap` expect that key; on its own the name does not say what the UMAP is based on. The other UMAP is shown as a comparison. If the key is missing from the object, the report falls back to `X_umap_scvi`, then `X_umap_pca`, then `X_umap`, and says so.

umap_color_by.description: Comma-separated obs columns to plot on the UMAPs in the QC/clustering and analysis reports, e.g. `sex,diagnosis`.
umap_color_by.help_text: Each column is plotted on every UMAP listed in `--umap_color_by_embeddings`. Columns missing from the object are listed in the report and skipped. Columns added with `--metadata` can be used. Applies to the reports of `-entry qc_clustering` and `-entry downstream`.

umap_color_by_embeddings.description: Comma-separated UMAPs (keys in adata.obsm) on which the `--umap_color_by` columns are plotted.
umap_color_by_embeddings.help_text: `X_umap_pca` is the UMAP before integration (PCA neighbour graph); `X_umap_scvi` is the UMAP after integration (scVI neighbour graph). The report shows one block per UMAP. Keys missing from the object are skipped with a note.

markers_uns_key.description: Specify uns key for storing marker genes
markers_uns_key.help_text: Any uns key for storing marker genes can be used.

markers_thr_adj_pvalue.description: Adjusted P-value threshold for detecting marker genes.

markers_pct_nz.description: Minimum fraction of cells expressing gene in group to consider it as marker gene.

markers_min_logfc.description: Minimum log-fold change to consider gene as marker gene.

markers_n_top.description: Number of N top genes to pick as marker genes.
markers_n_top.help: If more than N genes satisfy the marker gene thresholds the top N are saved in the marker gene json file.

geneset_enrichment_options.title: Gene set enrichment options
geneset_enrichment_options.description: Options for gene set enrichmnet analysis. Currently, the scanpy gProfiler wrapper is used.

enrich_max_out_group_fraction.description: Maximum fraction of cells outside of group expressing gene to consider it.

enrich_min_in_group_fraction.description: Minimum fraction of cells in group expressing gene to consider it.

enrich_min_fold_change.description: Log-fold change threshold to consider gene.

liana_options.title: LIANA+ options
liana_options.description: Options for LIANA+ ligand receptor analysis.

ortholog_hcop_directory.description: Directory holding the HCOP ortholog tables. Required for LIANA+ when `--species` is not human.
ortholog_hcop_directory.help_text: LIANA+ reads `<directory>/human_<species>_hcop_fifteen_column.txt.gz` (e.g. `human_mouse_hcop_fifteen_column.txt.gz`) to map its human ligand-receptor resource onto non-human data. Download the fifteen-column files from https://www.genenames.org/download/hcop/tsv/ (they are served from https://storage.googleapis.com/public-download-files/hcop/). Not needed for human data.

tool_options.title: Tool options
tool_options.description: Options for various tools used in the pipeline.

celltypist_model.description: Specify the models to use for the celltypist cell type annotation
celltypist_model.help_text: If you want to use multiple models, separate them with a comma. Available models can be found [here](https://www.celltypist.org/models).

celldex_reference.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the celldex references to use for the singleR cell type annotation.
celldex_reference.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the celldex references to use for the singleR cell type annotation before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 or 4 columns, and a header row. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/scdownstream/usage#cell-type-annotation).

resource_options.title: Resource options
resource_options.description: Options for resource allocation and CPU usage.

memory_scale.description: Scale the memory requirements for each process by this factor. Should be increased if you have a large number of cells.

use_gpu.description: Use GPU acceleration for tasks that support it

pipeline_options.title: Pipeline options
pipeline_options.description: Options for selecting which tools should be used for certain tasks

qc_only.description: Only run the preprocessing steps, skip the integration and clustering steps

skip_liana.description: Skip the LIANA step. For large datasets, the pipeline might fail due to high memory usage in this step. Use this option to skip it.

skip_rankgenesgroups.description: Skip the rank_genes_groups step. For large datasets, the pipeline might fail due to high memory usage in this step. Use this option to skip it.

prep_cellxgene.description: Prepare the output for visualisation in cellxgene

scVI_options.title: scVI/scANVI options
scVI_options.description: Options for the scVI and scANVI integration methods

scvi_n_latent.description: Number of latent dimensions for scVI/scANVI

scvi_n_hidden.description: Number of hidden units in the neural network for scVI/scANVI

scvi_n_layers.description: Number of layers in the neural network for scVI/scANVI

scvi_dispersion.help_text: Dispersion parameter for scVI/scANVI. Can be 'gene', 'gene-batch', 'gene-label', or 'gene-cell'.

scvi_gene_likelihood.help_text: Gene likelihood for scVI/scANVI. Can be 'zinb', 'nb', 'poisson', or 'normal'.

scvi_max_epochs.description: Maximum number of epochs for training scVI/scANVI. If not set, a heuristic provided by scVI/scANVI will be used.

scvi_categorical_covariates.help_text: If you want to use multiple covariates, separate them with a comma.

scvi_continuous_covariates.help_text: If you want to use multiple covariates, separate them with a comma.

pseudobulk_groupby_labels.description: Group by labels for pseudobulking. If you want to use multiple labels, separate them with a comma.

pseudobulk_min_num_cells.description: Minimum number of cells for pseudobulking

differential_genes_options.title: Differential genes options
differential_genes_options.description: Options for pseudobulk differential gene expression analysis.

diffgenes_contrasts.description: Path to the TSV file describing the contrasts to test
diffgenes_contrasts.help_text: Tab-separated file following the nf-core/differentialabundance contrasts definition. Required columns are `id`, `variable`, `reference` and `target`; the optional columns are `blocking`, `exclude_samples_col` and `exclude_samples_values`. Because the file is tab-separated, `blocking` and `exclude_samples_values` take **comma**-separated values (nf-core/differentialabundance uses semicolons there; this pipeline requires TSV and commas). One differential expression test is run per row, for every instance of the group label. See `assets/contrasts.tsv` for an example.

diffgenes_group_col.description: Obs column holding the group label to test within
diffgenes_group_col.help_text: Name of the obs column that holds the cluster or cell type label. Differential genes are computed separately for every instance of this label. The column must exist in the obs table of the input AnnData object.

diffgenes_sample_col.description: Obs column identifying the biological sample
diffgenes_sample_col.help_text: Name of the obs column that identifies the biological sample or replicate. Counts are summed per sample within each combination of the group label and the contrast variables to form the pseudobulk profiles.

diffgenes_min_counts.description: Minimum number of counts per pseudobulk sample
diffgenes_min_counts.help_text: Pseudobulk samples with fewer total counts are discarded before the differential expression test.

diffgenes_min_cells.description: Minimum number of cells per pseudobulk sample
diffgenes_min_cells.help_text: Pseudobulk samples aggregated from fewer cells are discarded before the differential expression test.

diffgenes_min_samples.description: Minimum number of pseudobulk samples per side of a contrast
diffgenes_min_samples.help_text: The threshold applies to each side of the contrast independently: both the target level and the reference level must be backed by at least this many pseudobulk samples. It is evaluated after the object has been split per instance of the group label, so a group label with too few samples on either side is skipped and produces no results table, rather than failing the run. Values below 2 are rejected because a contrast with a single sample on one side cannot be tested at all.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service
hook_url.help_text: Incoming hook URL for messaging service. Currently, MS Teams and Slack are supported.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.
